condition: FULL-LATENT — unanchored joint HPOP hierarchy learning
status: PRE-REGISTERED; a zero-checkpoint preliminary prefix was discarded before any gate or retained formal draw, and the corrected formal launch remains pending
scientific_question: When skill identities are learned jointly rather than externally anchored, does exact path marginalization enable reliable recovery of the reusable partial-order library, segmentation, skill co-clustering, and transition dynamics?
context: This experiment was designed after Condition C/C' revealed that fixed asymmetric pi*,P* create an anchored structure-to-index assignment problem. Unlike C/C', FULL-LATENT tests the unanchored matched finite-Markov HPOP hierarchy by inferring pi and P jointly with S,z,U and evaluating the posterior modulo global skill-label permutation.

authoritative_model.name: Stage6E matched finite-Markov specialization
authoritative_model.reason: This is the model used by the frozen matched synthetic corpus and Conditions A/B/C/C'. Generic CRP/GEM prose elsewhere in the repository is not used for this finite K=3 formal corpus.

target_distribution: p(S,z,U,pi,P | X, rho_0=0.5, beta=1.5, omega=1.7346010553881064, lambda_rep=0.8, lambda_back=0.25, delta_B=0.15, epsilon=0.02)
inferred_variables: U: three latent structural coordinate matrices

rho_0.note: The supplied corpus has rho*=null. This is the registered Condition-B/C isolation value, not a claimed generating rho.

priors.U: Existing Stage6C row-iid Gaussian p(U_k|rho_0), unchanged.
priors.pi: Dirichlet(1,1,1), the existing Stage6E ETA_INITIAL=1 prior.
priors.P: Independently for every h, P[h, -h] ~ Dirichlet(1,1), with P[h,h]=0 exactly; this is the existing Stage6E ETA_TRANSITION=1 prior.

pi_P_updates.P: P[h,-h] | S,z ~ Dirichlet(1 + transition_counts[h,-h]); P[h,h]=0 exactly
pi_P_updates.order: P then pi, matching the existing frozen Stage6E implementation; their independent conditionals use the same freshly sampled paths.
pi_P_updates.validation: Before every forward/FFBS/marginal call and after every Gibbs update, require positive pi simplex, positive off-diagonal P rows summing to one, and exact zero diagonal.

data.split: 100 frozen training traces (25 each of J=24,32,40,48) and 45 frozen held-out traces (12,11,11,11); observed CPA arrays only are loaded online.
data.truth_seal: The runner loads only named observed CPA arrays. A fresh-process import probe forbids legacy generator/truth modules before every formal launch; it never opens truth_manifest.json or hidden NPZ fields. Terminal recovery is a separate explicit-unseal program.

arms.FULL-COND: At the common structural cadence, one uniformly selected (skill,row) Gaussian U proposal is scored against the current explicit (S,z) complete-path likelihood plus p(U|rho_0).
arms.FULL-MARG: At that same cadence, the identical proposal is scored by sum_n log Z_n(U; current pi,P) plus p(U|rho_0). It never reads stored S,z before FFBS.

kernel_schedule.structural_proposal: One uniform skill and one uniform row; existing symmetric propose_row family; common scale 0.5 (the parent registered Stage6C generic row scale).
kernel_schedule.structural_cadence: every 10 absolute sweeps in both arms; there are no ordinary conditional U row sweeps in either arm.
FULL-COND: exact all-trace FFBS refresh of S,z at current U,pi,P
FULL-MARG: exact all-trace FFBS refresh of S,z at current U,pi,P
kernel_schedule.validity_argument: For fixed pi,P, the marginal U MH leaves p(U|X,pi,P) invariant and reads no paths. Exact FFBS then draws p(S,z|U,pi,P,X), restoring the joint target before P/pi Gibbs read the refreshed paths. Conditional U MH instead leaves p(U|S,z,X,pi,P) invariant; the following FFBS and Gibbs transitions are ordinary exact conditional kernels. Thus both composed kernels preserve the same target.

fairness.only_difference: The likelihood term used to score the one structural U proposal.
fairness.no_additive_C_schedule: The prior C-MARG additive schedule is expressly not reused.

U.construction: Existing dispersed wrong-structure Gaussian construction at rho_0=0.5; no truth alignment.

starts.S_z: A deterministic legal tiling with cyclic labels; exact FFBS replaces it on sweep one. It is shared exactly across paired arms and has no truth input.

pi_P.construction: Independent legal prior draws using pi~Dirichlet(1,1,1) and each P[h,-h]~Dirichlet(1,1), with no true pi/P input.

starts.pairing: For each index 0..3, FULL-COND and FULL-MARG start from byte-identical U,S,z,pi,P states. No Condition C/C' terminal state is used.

convergence.implementation: Existing rank-normalized split-R-hat, bulk ESS, and tail ESS implementation.
convergence.movement_requirement: Every chain must have at least one accepted H-changing structural move.
convergence.stopping_rule: Each arm stops after two consecutive PASS checkpoints; the ceiling is 100000 sweeps and is never extended.
summaries: total relations and sorted per-skill relation counts
total segments, mean segments per trace, mean and SD segment length
32 deterministic corpus-hash-selected boundary indicators and dataset aggregates
64 deterministic corpus-hash-selected co-skill and same-segment indicators
sorted pi, pi entropy, pi L2 norm
P Frobenius norm, trace(P^2), trace(P^3), sorted row entropies, sorted stationary probabilities
convergence.permutation_rule: Every formal gate summary is verified against every one of the 3!=6 simultaneous label permutations. Raw skill-index-specific R-hat is not used.

terminal_recovery.unseal_rule: Only after both arms are terminal under the registered stopping rule or the registered ceiling; no recovery or held-out tuning during sampling.
terminal_recovery.alignment: Hungarian assignment on per-skill transitive-closure Hamming cost; enumerate the six tied optima only to choose the lexicographically smallest mapping. Apply that one learned-to-truth mapping to H, pi, both axes of P, and z.
outcomes: exact unordered library recovery and retained-draw probability
per-skill/aggregate closure F1 and normalized closure Hamming
fixed-pair co-skill Brier and pairwise F1
aligned off-diagonal P RMSE, Frobenius error, and row TV
terminal_recovery.heldout_nll: For each retained posterior draw and each of the frozen 45 held-out traces, exact forward DP gives log Z_n; subtract log C_J(delta_B), then use per-trace log-mean-exp across posterior draws. Primary NLL/occurrence is -sum_n log mean_d p(x_n|theta_d) / total held-out occurrences.

prelaunch_integrity_amendment.reason: The initial zero-checkpoint prefix exposed two implementation/provenance defects before any formal gate: duplicate gate evaluation could double-count a checkpoint on resume, and a historical frozen-model import transitively loaded legacy generator truth.
corrections_before_valid_formal_launch: Gate records certify their exact checkpoint iteration, are atomic, are never recomputed on resume, and a later checkpoint cannot backfill a missing earlier gate.
Formal runtime is import-sealed in a fresh subprocess; historical generator imports are lazy and outside the live sampler path.
Retained U is exact float64 under checkpoint schema 2 so terminal closures and held-out forwards represent sampled draws exactly.
The terminal-only recovery driver, shared Hungarian alignment, held-out calculation, and unseal guard are frozen before the valid formal launch.
prelaunch_integrity_amendment.disposition: The discarded prefix contributes no checkpoint, retained draw, gate, convergence result, recovery result, or scientific conclusion. Starts, priors, target, kernel schedules, thresholds, data, and no-rescue rule are unchanged.

no_rescue_rule: No global skill-swap, transposition, 3-cycle, arbitrary permutation, tempering, rescue kernel, data change, K change, nuisance-parameter inference, post-launch proposal tuning, threshold modification, truth-informed start, or held-out-based tuning will be added after launch.
